title: Finite labelled affine covers with pair, overlap and subordinate triple refinements
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. A finite affine refinement shape consists of a finite labelled set $L=\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, a subset $A\subseteq L$ of main labels, subsets $P_{ab},O_{rs},T_{abc}\subseteq L$, a choice $\sigma(a,b,c,t)\in L\times L\times L$, and a subset $E\subseteq L\times L$ of specified incidences. A family $(C_d)_{d\in L}$ of opens of $X$ is valid for this shape if every $C_d$ is affine; $\bigcup_{a\in A}C_a=X$; $\bigcup_{r\in P_{ab}}C_r=C_a\cap C_b$ for $a,b\in A$; $\bigcup_{t\in O_{rs}}C_t=C_r\cap C_s$ for $r,s\in P_{ab}$ and $a,b\in A$; and $\bigcup_{t\in T_{abc}}C_t=C_a\cap C_b\cap C_c$ for $a,b,c\in A$. For every such triple label $t$, the three components of $\sigma(a,b,c,t)$ belong respectively to $P_{ab},P_{ac},P_{bc}$ and their opens contain $C_t$. Finally $C_d\subseteq C_e$ for $(d,e)\in E$. Empty covering sets are allowed, and different labels may denote the same open. This is only a package of the chosen charts and equations; it asserts no existence or descent.
